name: io.github.paraphern/rugsnare
title: RugSnare
description: Pin the MCP tool contracts your agent was approved on (name + description + inputSchema, sha-256) and fail CI when a server silently changes them. This MCP surface serves two read-only tools: drift_feed_status (current versions and contract-change events of popular MCP servers, from the public RugSnare drift feed) and pins_report (the local pin store). The CLI behind it adds scan/diff/approve for CI gating.
